summary: AGI Inc filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that S&P Global Ratings upgraded its subsidiary Agibank's credit rating from brAA- to brAA with a stable outlook. This follows previous upgrades by Moody's Local and Fitch in 2026, bringing Agibank to AA-level ratings from all three agencies. The filing includes no transaction, no special situation, and no corporate action affecting shareholders. It is purely a routine credit rating announcement by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms or strategic events are present. The event is informational, with no impact on valuation or corporate structure.
